description: This file contains Polymer framework features, including template preparation, DOM manipulation, custom element registration, and shadow DOM distribution logic, primarily for Polymer mini.html component.

classes.name: DomApi
classes.description: Provides DOM manipulation and observation methods, including node insertion, removal, cloning, and event handling, with support for Shadow DOM and Shady DOM.

classes.name: DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: Wrapper for classList property, allowing class manipulation with automatic distribution updates.

classes.name: DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: Observes effective DOM nodes, including content and distributed nodes, with support for Shadow DOM mutation observation.

classes.name: DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: Specialized observer for distributed nodes in Shadow DOM, extending EffectiveNodesObserver.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a DomApi instance for a given node.

methods.name: hasDomApi
methods.description: Checks if a node has an associated DomApi instance.

methods.name: distributeNodeInto
methods.description: Distributes a node into a content insertion point.

methods.name: clearDistributedDestinationInsertionPoints
methods.description: Clears destination insertion points for distributed nodes.

methods.name: maybeRedistributeParent
methods.description: Marks parent for redistribution if needed.

methods.name: isFinalDestination
methods.description: Checks if a node is at its final destination in distribution.

methods.name: isInsertionPoint
methods.description: Determines if a node is an insertion point ('content').

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a node before a reference node, handling distribution and parentage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a node from its parent, updating distribution info.

methods.name: getTopDistributingHost
methods.description: Finds the top host needing redistribution.

methods.name: hostNeedsRedistribution
methods.description: Checks if a host needs redistribution based on content nodes.

methods.name: notifyContentObservers
methods.description: Notifies content observers of distribution changes.

methods.name: notifyInitialDistribution
methods.description: Notifies initial distribution to a host.

methods.name: upgradeLightChildren
methods.description: Upgrades light DOM children to custom elements if needed.
